course.title: Computer Science Engineering BSc | University of Debrecen
quotes: The tuition fee for this program is 7,000 USD/Year
This is a 3.5-year program consisting of 7 academic semesters
This is supplemented by the application fee of $150 USD (one-time) and the entrance procedure fee of $350 USD
All courses are taught in English ; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
Admission requires a high school certificate; an English Placement Test with an Oral Entrance Exam and passing a written and oral entrance exam in Mathematics and Physics.
